title: Saving water in the driest place on Earth
speaker: BBC Learning English

keywords.def: remove the liquid from something by pouring it out or letting it flow away
stick or hold onto something very tightly
make something start to happen or develop more quickly
at some unspecified point in the future
(idiom) the real results of something happening now will not be known until some time in the future

sentences.en: Hello. This is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 大家好，这里是BBC学英语的6分钟英语栏目。

sentences.en: I’m Neil. And I’m Beth. We all know how horrible it feels to be thirsty.
sentences.zh: 我是尼尔。我是贝丝。我们都知道口渴的感觉有多糟糕。

sentences.en: Human bodies need around 3 litres of water a day, and thankfully most of us can just turn on the kitchen tap to get clean drinking water.
sentences.zh: 人体每天大约需要3升水，谢天谢地，我们大多数人只需打开厨房水龙头就能喝到干净的饮用水。

sentences.en: But globally, over two billion people, around a quarter of the world’s population, live in water stressed countries, where access to water for drinking, cooking, and washing is not guaranteed.
sentences.zh: 但在全球范围内，超过20亿人（约占世界人口的四分之一）生活在水资源紧缺的国家，他们饮用、做饭和洗漱用水无法得到保证。

sentences.en: What’s more, water is also needed to grow food and that’s getting harder due to droughts which are increasing with climate change.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，种植农作物也需要水，而随着气候变化导致的干旱日益加剧，这件事变得越来越难。

sentences.en: In this programme, we’ll visit farmers in one of the driest places on Earth – Yuma in the USA - where a new technology involving liquid clay is helping farmers grow fruit and vegetables in the desert.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将拜访地球上最干燥的地方之一——美国尤马的农民。在那里，一项涉及液态粘土的新技术正在帮助农民在沙漠中种植水果和蔬菜。

sentences.en: And, as usual, we’ll be learning some useful new vocabulary too.
sentences.zh: 而且，和往常一样，我们还会学习一些实用的新词汇。

sentences.en: But first I have a question for you, Neil.
sentences.zh: 但首先我有一个问题要问你，尼尔。

sentences.en: Everyone knows that plants need sunlight and water to grow, but soil is just as important.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，植物生长需要阳光和水，但土壤同样重要。

sentences.en: One of the most useful soils is clay, a dense, smooth soil which is very fertile but sticky.
sentences.zh: 最有用的土壤之一是粘土，这是一种致密、光滑的土壤，非常肥沃但有粘性。

sentences.en: Clay has been used in agriculture for thousands of years, but what is its more modern use?
sentences.zh: 粘土在农业中已经使用了数千年，但它更现代的用途是什么？

sentences.en: Is clay good for: a) curing headaches? b) digesting food? or, c) smoothing face skin?
sentences.zh: 粘土有何妙用：a) 治疗头痛？b) 消化食物？还是 c) 平滑面部皮肤？

sentences.en: Hmm, I think clay can be used to smooth the skin on people’s faces.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想粘土可以用来让人脸上的皮肤变得光滑。

sentences.en: OK, Neil. We’ll find out if that’s the correct answer later.
sentences.zh: 好的，尼尔。我们稍后会揭晓这是否是正确答案。

sentences.en: Lack of water and farming are closely connected.
sentences.zh: 缺水与农业息息相关。

sentences.en: Agriculture uses a massive 70% of the world’s fresh water supply, so ways to use water more efficiently are much needed.
sentences.zh: 农业消耗了全球70%的庞大淡水供应，因此非常需要更高效利用水资源的方法。

sentences.en: Ole Sivertsen’s company, Desert Control, works with date farmers in Yuma, an area on the border of California and Mexico.
sentences.zh: 奥莱·西弗森的公司“沙漠控制”与位于加利福尼亚和墨西哥边境地区尤马的枣椰农合作。

sentences.en: One of the hottest places on Earth, Yuma has been experiencing its worst drought in 500 years, forcing farmers to pump water from rivers to grow their date palm trees.
sentences.zh: 尤马是地球上最炎热的地方之一，正经历着500年来最严重的干旱，迫使农民从河流中抽水来种植枣椰树。

sentences.en: Fortunately, Ole’s team have created a liquid that, they say, can turn the sandy desert soil into a sponge which holds water and nutrients.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，奥莱的团队创造了一种液体，他们说这种液体可以把沙漠的沙质土壤变成像海绵一样能保持水分和养分的介质。

sentences.en: Here, he explains his invention to Anthony Wallace, reporter for BBC World Service programme, People Fixing the World: To understand how it works we need to look at the difference between sandy soil and clay soil.
sentences.zh: 在这里，他向BBC世界频道节目《拯救世界的泥瓦匠》的记者安东尼·华莱士解释了他的发明：要理解它是如何工作的，我们需要看看沙质土壤和粘土土壤之间的区别。

sentences.en: Sandy desert soil has a lot of gaps in it so water drains through it quickly, making it hard for plants to establish the root system in the ground.
sentences.zh: 沙漠沙质土壤中有很多空隙，所以水流失得很快，这使得植物很难在地面上建立根系。

sentences.en: But clay soil is made up of much smaller particles that cling together and naturally stop water from escaping.
sentences.zh: 但粘土是由更小的颗粒组成的，这些颗粒紧紧粘在一起，自然地阻止水分流失。

sentences.en: It creates the habitat for the soil microbiology to also start to develop and evolve, so it's kind of a kick-start as well to nature's natural processes.
sentences.zh: 它为土壤微生物开始发育和演化创造了栖息地，所以这也是对大自然自然过程的一种加速启动。

sentences.en: The problem with sandy soil is that it drains water.
sentences.zh: 沙质土壤的问题在于它会排水。

sentences.en: If you drain something, you remove the liquid from it.
sentences.zh: 如果你把什么东西里的液体排干，你就是去除了里面的液体。

sentences.en: Clay soil, on the other hand, is made of smaller particles which cling, or stick together tightly, and hold water, helping plants grow.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，粘土由紧密粘连在一起的微小颗粒组成，能够保持水分，帮助植物生长。

sentences.en: Ole makes a liquid by mixing clay and water which changes the soil composition and kick-starts the growth of his trees – the liquid makes the trees start growing more quickly.
sentences.zh: 奥莱通过将粘土和水混合制成一种液体，改变了土壤成分，并加速了他树木的生长——这种液体让树木开始生长得更快。

sentences.en: Liquid clay technology is still new, and costing around 2,000 dollars an acre, it’s not cheap.
sentences.zh: 液态粘土技术仍然很新，每英亩成本约为2000美元，并不便宜。

sentences.en: But Ole claims his technique halves the amount of water needed to grow fruit trees, and that most farmers will make back their investment within two years.
sentences.zh: 但奥莱声称，他的技术将种植果树所需的水量减半，并且大多数农民能在两年内收回投资。

sentences.en: Ole’s claims sound too good to be true. But are there downsides to interfering with nature in this way?
sentences.zh: 奥莱的说法听起来好得令人难以置信。但以这种方式干涉大自然有什么负面影响吗？

sentences.en: Presenters, Myra Anubi and Anthony Wallace, discussed this question for BBC World Service’s, People Fixing the World: Anthony, I'm still left wondering, right… when you manipulate soil like this, could you be causing problems down the line?
sentences.zh: 主持人迈拉·阿努比和安东尼·华莱士在BBC世界频道的节目《拯救世界的人》中讨论了这个问题：安东尼，我仍然感到好奇，对吧……当你这样操纵土壤时，你可能会在未来引发问题吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think anytime that there's a new technology where you are, like you said, manipulating nature only time will tell what the long-term effects of that will be… but Ole did stress that their liquid clay does not use any chemicals - only clay, air and water.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为任何时候只要有新技术，就像你说的，在操纵自然，只有时间才能证明其长期影响会是什么……但奥莱确实强调，他们的液态粘土不使用任何化学物质——只有粘土、空气和水。

sentences.en: Ole’s liquid clay involves manipulating soil – using and controlling it skilfully to achieve some result.
sentences.zh: 奥莱的液态粘土涉及对土壤的操纵——巧妙地使用和控制它以达到某种结果。

sentences.en: Myra worries that when people do this, they could create problems down the line – at some unspecified point in the future.
sentences.zh: 迈拉担心，当人们这样做时，他们可能会在未来某个不确定的时间点引发问题。

sentences.en: In fact, only time will tell if liquid clay is a long-term solution to the problem of water scarcity.
sentences.zh: 事实上，只有时间才能证明液态粘土是否是解决水资源短缺问题的长期方案。

sentences.en: The phrase, only time will tell, means that the result of something happening now will not be known until the future.
sentences.zh: “只有时间才能证明”这个短语意味着，现在发生的事情的结果要到将来才会知道。

sentences.en: Something we can know though, is the answer to my question, Neil.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们能知道的一件事就是我那个问题的答案，尼尔。

sentences.en: Yes, you asked about a modern use for clay, and I guessed it was for smoothing facial skin.
sentences.zh: 是的，你问的是粘土的现代用途，我猜那是用来平滑面部皮肤的。

sentences.en: Which was… the correct answer! A clay mask, also called a mud pack, is used to smooth the skin on your face.
sentences.zh: 答案是……正确答案！粘土面膜，也称为泥膜，用于使脸部皮肤光滑。

sentences.en: OK, let’s recap the vocabulary we’ve learned in this programme, starting with the verb to drain which means to remove liquid.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们回顾一下我们在本节目中学到的词汇，首先是动词 to drain，意思是排出液体。

sentences.en: To cling means to stick or hold tightly onto something.
sentences.zh: To cling 的意思是紧紧粘住或抓牢某物。

sentences.en: If you kick-start something, you make it start or develop more quickly.
sentences.zh: 如果你 kick-start 某事，你就会让它更快开始或发展。

sentences.en: To manipulate means to skilfully use or control something.
sentences.zh: To manipulate 的意思是巧妙地使用或控制某物。

sentences.en: The phrase, down the line, means some time in the future.
sentences.zh: 短语 down the line 意思是将来的某个时候。

sentences.en: And finally, the idiom, only time will tell, means that the truth about something happening now will only be known in the future.
sentences.zh: 最后，习语 only time will tell 的意思是，关于现在正在发生的事情的真相只有在未来才会为人所知。

sentences.en: Once again our six minutes are up, but remember to join us again next time for more trending topics and useful vocabulary, here at 6 Minute English.
sentences.zh: 我们的六分钟节目又到时间了，但请记住下次继续收看我们带来的更多热门话题和实用词汇，就在6分钟英语。

sentences.en: Goodbye for now! Bye!
sentences.zh: 先到这里，再见！再见！
